events.title: God's Love
events.subtitle: God loves you
story: First, God loves you, and he has a good purpose in mind for your life. The Bible puts it this way. God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who trusts in him will not be lost but will have life that never ends.

In the beginning God made light, and the sky, and the earth. He shaped a human being from the dust and breathed the breath of life into him. You are not here by accident. You were made to walk with God and to live inside his love.
Jesus said, I came so that people may have life, and have it overflowing. So why do so many people never come to know this love and this full life?

words.text: God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who trusts in him will not be lost but will have life that never ends.
I have loved you with a love that lasts forever. That is why I have kept drawing you to me with faithful love.
I came so that people may have life, and have it overflowing.

events.note: Genesis says that people were made in the image of God (Gen 1:27). The whole Bible runs as one story: God loves people and calls them into a life lived together with him.
events.reflect: Can I believe that I am someone God loves?

quiz.q: According to the Bible, how did God make human beings?
options: By mixing dust and water by chance
quiz.explain: God made people in his own image (Gen 1:27), and breathed the breath of life into the one he had shaped from the dust (Gen 2:7).

events.title: Sin and Separation
events.subtitle: Sin has cut us off from God
story: Second, our sin has put us at a distance from God. That is why we cannot know his love or enjoy it. The Bible says, everyone has sinned, and no one reaches the glory of God.

In Eden, the man and the woman followed their own thinking instead of God's word, and ate the fruit he had told them not to eat. Sin is not only a few wrong things we do. It is turning away from God and making myself the one in charge of my life. The Bible says, the wages of sin is death.
People try to cross that gap by being good, by working hard at spiritual discipline, by searching through religion. But no one can reach God by their own strength. So is there no way at all?

words.text: Everyone has sinned, and no one reaches the glory of God.
The wages of sin is death, but the gift God gives freely is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
It is your sins that have come between you and your God.

events.note: The cherubim and the flaming sword that turned every way, guarding the east of Eden, show that people cannot find their own way back to the tree of life (Gen 3:24). The story of how this closed road is opened again runs through the whole Bible.
events.reflect: Who have I put in charge of my life?

quiz.q: What does the Bible say are the wages of sin?
quiz.explain: The wages of sin is death, but God's gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus (Rom 6:23).

events.title: Jesus, the Only Way
events.subtitle: Jesus Christ alone is the way
story: Third, Jesus Christ is the one way God has made to deal with our sin. Only through him can we know God's love and live in it. Jesus said, I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

Jesus, the Son of God, became a human being and came to us. Then on the cross at Golgotha, the one who had no sin paid the price of our sin in our place. The Bible says, while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
At dawn on the third day, the tomb was empty. Jesus had beaten death and risen to life again, and he appeared to many people. Now he has become the one and only bridge between God and us.

words.text: I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
While we were still sinners, Christ died for us. This is how God showed his love for us.
Christ died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said, he was buried, and on the third day he was raised to life.

events.note: Paul reports that the risen Jesus appeared to Peter, to the Twelve, and then to more than five hundred people at one time, and he adds that many of them are still alive (1 Cor 15:5–6).
events.reflect: When I hear that Jesus carried the cross for me, what stirs in my heart?

quiz.q: Jesus said no one can come where, except through him?
quiz.explain: I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me (Jn 14:6).

events.title: The Response of Faith
events.subtitle: Welcome him in by faith
story: Fourth, each one of us needs to welcome Jesus Christ as our Savior and as the Lord of our life. Then we come to know God's love and live in it. The Bible says, to all who welcomed him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.

Welcoming him is not something we earn by doing good. It is God's gift, received by faith. It means turning away from running my own life, and placing my life in Jesus' hands. Jesus said, look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to them. Right now, who is in charge of your life?

If this prayer is what your heart wants to say, pray it with me now. Jesus, I am a sinner. I have turned away from God and lived my own way. I believe that you died on the cross for me and rose to life again. Right now I open the door of my heart. Please come in, forgive my sins, and be the Lord of my life. Thank you for taking me in as a child of God. I pray in your name, Jesus. Amen.

words.text: Look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to them and eat with them, and they will eat with me.
To all who welcomed him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.
You have been saved by grace, through faith. This does not come from you. It is the gift of God.

events.note: Prayer is not reciting fixed words. It is the answer of your heart to God. If you have prayed this prayer sincerely, we encourage you to find a church near you and meet people who will walk this road with you.
events.reflect: If Jesus is knocking at the door of my heart right now, how will I answer him?

quiz.q: According to John 1:12, what is given to those who welcome Jesus?
options: The right to become children of God
quiz.explain: To all who welcomed him, to those who believed in his name, was given the right to become children of God (Jn 1:12).

ui.gospelHead: The good news of this way
ui.gospel:
God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life. (John 3:16)
We had turned from God to go our own way and were lost in sin, but Jesus carried that sin for us, died on the cross, and rose again on the third day. (1 Cor 15:3–4)
To all who believe in him and receive him, he gives the right to become children of God. (John 1:12)

ui.blessing:
May you be blessed, you who have walked this way.
May the road he walked now become your own.
May the one who clothes the lilies of the field care for your tomorrow, and the one who stilled the wind and the waves give peace to your heart.
Like the morning of the empty tomb, may light dawn over every darkness you face.
And do not forget: he is with you always, to the very end of the age. (Matt 28:20)
ui.invite:
Where is Jesus right now? Just as he promised, he has come into your life. He said that if you open the door, he will come in. (Rev 3:20)
You are now a child of God. The proof is not your feelings but his promise. (Jn 1:12)
God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. Whoever has the Son has life. (1 Jn 5:11–12)
Now find a church near you and meet people who will walk this road with you, and open the Bible each day to hear his words. Walking the way of Jesus from the very beginning is also a good place to start.
ui.prayer: Jesus, I believe that you came to this earth because you love me, and that you carried the cross for me. Please be the Lord of my life, and receive me as a child of God. Amen.
